capabilities: Format entire notes or only the selected content
Format embedded code blocks in js(x), ts(x), css, scss, less, html, json, and yaml
Remap code block languages to another language before formatting
Add trailing spaces to empty list items for correct live preview rendering
Enable or disable formatting per file via frontmatter
extras: The README cites an original plugin repository as inspiration but its name is not given; settings include ignore patterns and JSON-formatted Prettier options.
intentEvidence: Since that repository is not actively maintained and does not declare an open source license, I have re-implemented its features
motivation: The author re-implemented an earlier unmaintained plugin (which had no open-source license) and added new features.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to automatically format Markdown or code blocks inside notes to a consistent style.
summary: Prettier-based formatter that formats whole notes or selections, including embedded code blocks, with configurable options.
